title: Reports
description: See a summary of a year, or download your neurons and transactions as CSV files.
footnote: All dates are in UTC. These reports are not financial or tax advice.

yearSummary.title: Year summary
yearSummary.subtitle: Values in {{currency}}, at the rate of each day.
yearSummary.notIncluded: What the summary does not include

limits.externalDisbursements: Rewards that you disbursed to an account outside this app, for example an exchange.
limits.pastMaturity: The maturity at the end of a past year. No canister keeps a history of maturity.
limits.deviceNeurons: Neurons on a Ledger device that do not have your Internet Identity as a hotkey.
limits.gains: Gains, losses, and the cost basis. The app does not know your purchase prices.
limits.rates: If a day has no rate, the summary uses the rate of an earlier day. The CSV file shows the date of each rate.

yearSummary.incomplete: Some accounts have too many transactions. The summary does not include the oldest ones.
yearSummary.error: The year summary did not load.

settingsRow.description: A year summary and CSV exports of your neurons and transactions.

neurons.title: Neurons
neurons.description: The stake, maturity, dissolve delay, and state of each neuron, as of today.
neurons.error: The neurons report failed. Try again.

transactions.title: Transactions
transactions.description: The transactions of all your accounts and neuron accounts in the period, with the {{currency}} value of each one.
transactions.invalidRange: Select a start date and an end date. The end date cannot be before the start date.
transactions.rangeTooLong: The period can be one year at most.
transactions.empty: You have no transactions in this period.
transactions.incomplete: Some accounts have too many transactions. The file does not include the oldest ones.
transactions.error: The transactions report failed. Try again.
